lessons: Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesign (adoption, redesign) was helpful in one confirmed winning test, though a second test showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for most other specific categories (path layout/copy/redesign, home status/redesign, finish notification/redesign, sign-in reordering) as each has only been tested once.
